headline: None of the ten assessed tasks is closable to completed at candidate e60baf9. Every verdict below is grounded in commands run in a detached clean worktree of that commit (see the per-cluster evidence files) because the primary checkout carried uncommitted mid-flight edits from the redaction and barrier lanes. Two structural facts block most closures independently of test results: (1) scripts/check-task-graph.mjs fails 'completed-dependency-open' for any completed task with a non-completed predecessor, and every assessed task has at least one open predecessor; (2) several registered expected_artifacts paths name locations the work did not land at, and the evidence-closure artifact rule matches the exact registered path or files strictly below it.
